latest_release.name: v2.3.0
latest_release.body:
This version includes several deprecations, detailed below. This aligns with the current scope of Sopa, i.e., mainly maintaining (1) the API and (2) the Nextflow pipeline.

## Added
* Enable GPU usage for InstanSeg by @quentinblampey in https://github.com/prism-oncology/sopa/pull/461

## Changes
* Deprecate the snakemake pipeline by @quentinblampey in https://github.com/prism-oncology/sopa/pull/458 - we now recommend using [nf-core/sopa](https://nf-co.re/sopa/) instead. The snakemake workflow was archived [here](https://github.com/prism-oncology/snakemake-sopa).
* Remove support for python 3.11 by @quentinblampey in https://github.com/prism-oncology/sopa/pull/460 in favor of python 3.14 now being added to the CI
* Deprecate tangram by @quentinblampey in https://github.com/prism-oncology/sopa/pull/460
* Never clip values by 0.99 quantile in raw readers by @quentinblampey in https://github.com/prism-oncology/sopa/pull/457

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/prism-oncology/sopa/compare/v2.2.12...v2.3.0
